experiment.purpose: Falsify or support the current hypothesis that Clay-repository GitHub Actions admission/transport is the immediate receipt-production blocker before spending another cycle on parser semantics.
experiment.change: Added one inert GO transport-probe comment to the existing heartbeat workflow so the existing push path would be retriggered.
experiment.rollback: Remove the inert probe comment; no ClayCode, Frank, Harness, workflow behavior, authority or acceptance semantics were changed.

observations: GitHub accepted the heartbeat-trigger commit on main.
The same LATEST receipt remained absent on two independent post-trigger reads inside the bounded invocation window, including a final read at approximately 06:32 +07:00.
A compare immediately after the trigger observed main identical to the trigger commit, so no heartbeat receipt-writer commit had landed at that observation point.
Previously preserved PR #52 run 31327468352 / rerun job 93280085034 remains a completed failure with no exposed steps/logs and did not execute its intended dispatch.
Fresh GitHub public status observation reports GitHub Actions operational, weakening a current global Actions outage explanation but not proving repository-local root cause.
allowed_conclusion: NO_HEARTBEAT_RECEIPT_OBSERVED_IN_BOUNDED_WINDOW. Step-executed GitHub-hosted Actions admission for the Clay repository is still unproven in this cycle. Existing evidence continues to localize the immediate uncertainty to Actions admission/policy/scheduling/transport rather than ClayCode parser semantics, but root cause remains UNKNOWN.
forbidden_conclusions: Do not claim the heartbeat workflow definitively failed without an observed run/job receipt.
Do not infer permanent GitHub Actions or permanent self-hosted runner misconfiguration.
Do not classify this as a ClayCode parser/compiler/runtime failure.
Do not promote WP02, BASE, Frank Harness or any release gate from this event.
Do not treat model confidence or worker consensus as execution evidence.

work_delta.next_falsifier: Resolve repository/account Actions admission with authoritative settings/billing/runner-scope evidence or observe one step-executed exact-SHA heartbeat. Only then resume receipt-dependent V17 WP02/WP06 VPS execution.
work_delta.duplicate_probe_policy: Do not create another semantically equivalent Actions probe until relevant transport state changes or a new discriminator becomes available.

evidence_scope: Operational transport localization only. Not scientific promotion, not target-host acceptance, not a Frank runtime result.
